decision.authority: owner d1b9f3c0 / correction7d8d831e; worker w5 first homepage review
decision.rationale: UBC Learning Spaces provides public classroom, study-space, course-recording and design support for the university. Its homepage includes a distinct News & Announcements section. It is not exclusively Okanagan-serving: it describes UBC-wide learning spaces and names Allard Hall and Gateway Health facilities.
evidence: https://learningspaces.ubc.ca/ | 633986e33d83bb1b6da7e75121e438df88dd7d1b878d63e4e1f3b0e12034b93f | Outstanding learning spaces are critical to UBC’s academic mission. We create inspiring spaces that support excellence in teaching and learning.

https://learningspaces.ubc.ca/ | 633986e33d83bb1b6da7e75121e438df88dd7d1b878d63e4e1f3b0e12034b93f | Find a classroom; Classroom recording and streaming; Learning Spaces Design Guidelines; Find an informal space

https://learningspaces.ubc.ca/ | 633986e33d83bb1b6da7e75121e438df88dd7d1b878d63e4e1f3b0e12034b93f | News & Announcements; $40M gift to UBC is the largest ever to a Canadian school of nursing; State-of-the-art Gateway Health building opens as integrated hub for student health, teaching and research; Upgrading accessibility at Allard Hall with new sit-stand desks

rules.rationale: Explicit news and announcement sections report learning-space developments rather than provide ongoing support guidance.
The homepage explicitly lists these reports in News & Announcements.
rules.title_pattern: ^(?:News\s*(?:&|and)\s*Announcements|\$40M gift to UBC is the largest ever to a Canadian school of nursing|State-of-the-art Gateway Health building opens as integrated hub for student health, teaching and research|Upgrading accessibility at Allard Hall\s+with new sit-stand desks)(?:$|\s*[|–—-])

fallback.rationale: The host's primary purpose is practical support for finding, using and designing UBC learning spaces and classroom recording facilities.
